# Studio Tools

> Free online image, OCR and PDF tools that run in your browser or on a private server. Files are processed for your request only and deleted afterwards.

## Image tools

- [Background Remover](https://studiotools.tech/remove-background): cut out the subject as a transparent PNG
- [AI Upscaler](https://studiotools.tech/upscale): enlarge images 2x or 4x
- [Object Remover](https://studiotools.tech/object-remover): erase people, text and clutter with AI inpainting
- [Photo Restoration](https://studiotools.tech/photo-restoration): reduce noise, repair scratches, revive faded photos, colorize, enhance faces
- [Social Media Resizer](https://studiotools.tech/social-media-resizer): exact sizes for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and TikTok
- [Image Compressor](https://studiotools.tech/compress), [Crop](https://studiotools.tech/crop), [Editor](https://studiotools.tech/editor)

## Documents

- [Document Scanner](https://studiotools.tech/document-scanner): photos of paper to flat, clean scans and PDFs
- [OCR Editor](https://studiotools.tech/ocr): extract English and Nepali text from images and PDFs
- [PDF tools](https://studiotools.tech/documents): merge, split, compress, convert, sign, protect and unlock PDFs

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://studiotools.tech/sitemap.xml)
